notes: The key chain through MCP tokens (design spec §10). A secret is an authorization code, an access token or a refresh token: 32 random bytes.
wire is the form the secret travels in: base64url of the bytes, no padding. hash = SHA-256(UTF-8 bytes of wire), lowercase hex; it is the only form the vault stores.
k = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = the 32 secret bytes, salt = empty, info = "scribe/v1/token-kek", 32 bytes). It wraps the Library Key for that one secret.
wrapAad is tokenWrapAad(libraryId, kind, hash) = <libraryId>/mcp/<kind>/<hash>, kind one of code, access, refresh.
Node (crypto/token-kek.ts) and the browser (lib/kdf.ts) must both derive k from secret.
